{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders removed:", qa_mask.sum())

# Drop QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Drop refunded orders — keep only completed
completed_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_customers = completed_orders[completed_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute mean revenue for loyal customers
mean_revenue_loyal = loyal_customers['revenue'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue_loyal"}
